params.body:
## What changes for the dealer

On the photo tab, in "Eigen website en zoekertjes", selecting photos now always offers **Achtergrond verwijderen (N)** next to "Naar Stocklist kopiëren (N)" and "Verwijderen (N)". The question before it names the count and the cost unit ("Achtergrond verwijderen van 6 foto's?", "Elke foto is één bewerking bij remove.bg … Het origineel blijft bewaard"). Each photo is its own job; when the series ends, one notify names the photos that did not go through by their place in the grid ("Achtergrond niet verwijderd bij foto 3, 7. Het origineel staat er nog."). A tile whose background was removed gets **Origineel terugzetten**.

## Step 1: what existed (mapped before building)

- **remove.bg** (`Photo::old_remove_background`, called from `ProcessImage::removeBG`): one call per photo, `size=preview`, `type=car`, the dealer's background sent as bytes. The result is written next to the original as `trans_path` (`<name>.png`) with a thumbnail; `path` is the original. **Blurit** (`BluritService::BlurLicense`) only runs when the job has `blur` on; its webhook (`ImageController::processed`) writes `trans_<name>.png` and a new `media_version`.
- **Platform copies** (`stocklist = 1`): `ProcessImage` with `duplicate` (copy the own photo, remove background, blur). "Blur weghalen" is `redo=1` (copy again, no blur).
- **Own photos already had both actions**: the wand on a single tile (`removeBg?blur=0`: background off, no blur, R S1-6.5) and a bulk wand in the own toolbar (R S1-6.31). Nothing in `docs/bedrijfsregels` or the code excludes own photos on purpose; the rule text says they go "zoals ze zijn" to the website and the portals, and the edited version is what they show (R S1-6.25, `PublicVehicleResource` reads `trans_path` first).
- **Why it looked missing**: the bulk wand was behind `x-show="sel === 0 || selBg > 0"`, with `selBg` = selected photos WITHOUT a platform copy, and the whole block was only rendered when such a photo existed. On a shared vehicle every own photo has a copy, so the bar showed only copy and delete. That gate dates from August 2026 ("al-uitgeknipte foto's"), before own photos and platform copies were split; a platform copy says nothing about the background of the own photo.
- **Cost**: one remove.bg call per photo (`size=preview`), paid from the platform key (bevinding de-remove-bg-sleutel-is-een-platforminstelling), not by the dealer. On 24 September 2026 a run of 443 calls moved the balance from 1,674.25 to 1,584.25, about 0.2 credit per photo, inflated by other activity in those hours (bevinding de-kostregel-beweerde-een-prijs). The balance is in `stocklist:smoke removebg`. Per that finding the UI names the unit (one remove.bg job per photo) and no price.
- **Seal**: `ProcessImage` fakes remove.bg and Blurit outside production unless `removebg` / `blurit` is in `OUTBOUND_ALLOW` (R S1-6.10). remove.bg is a read/compute service, so `allows('removebg')` is the check; nothing is created at a third party, so `impact()` does not apply.
- **Interior photos** ("Could not identify foreground", Nightwatch #24): R S1-6.8 already decides this: the original is written as the cut-out, logged, not reported, the photo counts as done.

## Three findings fixed on the way

- **bevinding: bulk-achtergrond-blurde-de-eigen-fotos**: the bulk branch dispatched with `blur = true` on own photos, so they also went through Blurit and the own website got a blurred plate, while the question said "zonder blur" and the tile wand sent `blur=0`. Own photos now go through `OwnPhotoBackground::queue` with the tile's job (no copy, no blur). The `redo=1` path for platform copies is unchanged.
- **bevinding: achtergrond-verwijderen-verdween-bij-een-selectie**: the gate above; with a selection the button now stays and counts `sel`, and the script sends `again=1` so the server processes the named photos even when they already have a cut-out. Without a selection nothing changes (the photos that still have a background, already cut-out ones skipped).
- **bevinding: uitgeknipte-png-overschreef-het-origineel**: the cut-out name was `explode('.', $path)[0] . '.png'`, so a PNG upload (`ProcessVehiclePhoto` keeps the upload's extension) had remove.bg's answer written over its original and its thumbnail. `PhotoNames::cutOut()` keeps every existing name and gives such a photo `_nobg`. Not counted on production; rows with `trans_path = path` are the affected ones, and "Origineel terugzetten" does not offer itself there.

## How the original is kept, and how it comes back

The original is `path` and is never written by remove.bg. `OwnPhotoBackground::restore()` (POST `image/{id}/restore-original`, owner only, own photos only, not while processing, only when the original is on the disk) clears `trans_path`/`trans_thumbnail_path`, warms the derived sizes of `path` under a new `media_version`, and deletes the cut-out files unless another row (a vehicle copy, a platform copy) still names them. Every URL goes through `VehicleImageService::urlVoor()` with the version, so nothing keys on the reused path.

## Other details

- `removeBgImages` returns 200/`false` for an unknown vehicle instead of a 500, and an empty `images` list is no longer "every photo of the vehicle" (the repository drops an empty `whereIn`).
- A photo already processing is not queued twice.
- No new CSS (refresh.css unchanged), no new globals: `restoreOriginal` and `meldMislukteFotos` sit on the existing `vehicle` prototype; `ui.confirm` and `ui.notify` only.
- Rules: R S1-6.5 and R S1-6.31 updated, new R S1-6.41 (restore the original). Translations nl/fr/en/de.

## Screenshots

Selection bar with six own photos selected (all with a platform copy), 1440 and 390 wide: taken locally (`bg-own-1440.png`, `bg-own-390.png`): the button "Achtergrond verwijderen (6)" sits first in the bar, before "Naar Stocklist kopiëren (6)" and "Verwijderen (6)"; on a phone the three stack full width.

## Tests

`OwnPhotoBackgroundTest` (no real HTTP: `Http::fake`, `Queue::fake`, `Storage::fake`):
- one job per selected own photo, `duplicate=false, removeBg=true, blur=false`; `again` reprocesses a cut-out
- without a selection: cut-out, busy and platform photos skipped; an empty list queues nothing
- another dealer's photo ids are refused (bulk and restore, 403)
- sealed: no call leaves; with `removebg` in `OUTBOUND_ALLOW` exactly one call to remove.bg and none to Blurit
- one photo refused by remove.bg (402) keeps its original and gets the reason, the others go through; an interior ("Could not identify foreground") keeps its original; `media_version` changes when the bytes change
- a PNG original and its thumbnail are not overwritten
- restore: new `media_version`, cut-out files deleted, a shared file kept, a platform copy refused (422)
- the tab: the wand with any selection, the count in the question, the cost unit in four languages, restore only on a cut-out tile

`PhotoTabToolbarTest` and `PhotoProcessingProgressTest` follow the new label and signature. Full suite, PHPStan and Pint (new files) locally.
params.title: Remove the background of selected own photos, and put the original back
